notes: Original: condition labels and PDF p. 5 identify Study 1, whereas input study_o is 2; target_match is false. Extracted the within-condition pretest–posttest test, which is the condition-specific test printed there; the page also reports between-condition contrasts. Original PDF was visually checked to resolve OCR t/r errors. Replication: supplied emotional-control description does not match Study 2 thought-control manipulation, so target_match is false. Authors’ failed-replication verdict is study-level, not a verdict about an emotional-control condition. Replication r and p left null because p. 33 has two candidate outcomes and no emotional-control condition; assigning correlations by input order would be unsupported. The paper is available and these fields are unverified, not an acquisition failure.
